Introduction
This 
 document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must performed every two 
 months as indicated by M2 in the title block.
The Ljungstrom air heater absorbs waste heat from flue gases, then transfers this heat to incoming cold air to increase the temperature of the incoming combustion or air process.

Before 
Isolating the Air Heater Mechanically and Electrically
Check any abnormal 
 noise or vibration.
Check any air or flue 
 gases leakage from manholes.
Check the oil 
 level of upper guide bearing.
Check the oil
